about: BN4's TimeBomb J (its chip 97) against BN6's TimeBom1 F (144) by the comparator's MegaMan mode (docs/multirom/bn4-chips.md, unit 3): each picked on the first Custom screen and used at fight frame 30 against a Mettaur at (5,2). The census's question, whether BN4's support 0x11 is BN6's subfamily 10: the spawner and the object's states are the same by body, its placement is not (BN4 0x080E4DE4, BN6 0x080E45D0).
subject: megaman

verdict.why: Through t33 the two differ only where legit.json's bn4 section explains (the chip's id, the record's copies read as BN6's, the bomb's support object, BN6's support attack's end). At t34 the bomb lands on another panel: BN4's placement (0x080E4DE4, 55 instructions) is not BN6's (0x080E45D0, 14), though the object's other routines are the same by body. So BN4's TimeBomb is BN4's code to move, not a chip on BN6's TimeBom1's (docs/multirom/bn4-chips.md, Where things stand).
